workarounds.symptom: wait_for_everyone() raises NotImplementedError on MULTI_CPU when the machine has an MPS accelerator (barrier gets device_ids)
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Fix wait_for_everyone() crashing on MULTI_CPU when the machine has an accelerator. Target files: src/accelerate/state.py. `PartialState.wait_for_everyone()` passes `device_ids=[local_process_index]` to `torch.distributed.barrier()` for every distributed type, including `MULTI_CPU`. When `device_ids` is given, torch runs the barrier on the machine's accelerator (`torch._C._get_accelerator()`) instead of on the gloo/CPU process group. workarounds.symptom: compile_regions runs the uncompiled model when the root module has an accelerate hook
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Fix unwrap_model(keep_fp32_wrapper=False) breaking hooked models. Target files: src/accelerate/utils/other.py, tests/test_accelerator.py. `accelerator.unwrap_model(model, keep_fp32_wrapper=False)` no longer breaks the `forward` of a model that carries an accelerate hook. (Ref: https://github.com/huggingface/accelerate/pull/4255)
